description:
Project: Day-2 ops toolkit (backup/restore) for Redwood Private deployments (VPC + on-prem packaging).

Goals
- Deliver a reliable, repeatable backup/restore and disaster recovery (DR) toolkit for Redwood Private operators.
- Provide documented, versioned scripts plus operator runbooks that work across deployment modes: Kubernetes-in-VPC and on-prem (including partially/fully air-gapped environments).
- Reduce MTTR and operator error during incidents by standardizing procedures, validation checks, and rollback paths.

Scope (what’s included)
- Inventory + classification of state to protect: control-plane DBs (e.g., Postgres), object storage (model artifacts, logs), config/policy data, secrets/certificates, and customer-specific integrations (KMS/HSM, SIEM/audit export destinations).
- Backup mechanisms:
  - Scheduled backups (CronJob/Job patterns) with retention policies.
  - Encryption-at-rest and in-transit, with KMS/HSM integration where available.
  - Pluggable storage targets (S3/GCS/Azure Blob/NFS/minio) with an on-prem-friendly “staging repository” option.
- Restore mechanisms:
  - Full restore (new cluster / new VPC) and in-place restore.
  - Point-in-time restore (PITR) for DB where supported.
  - Validation gates: service health, data integrity checks, smoke tests against API.
- DR planning artifacts:
  - RPO/RTO guidance and a recommended “tiering” model (e.g., standard vs strict) tied to infrastructure cost.
  - Game day templates and evidence capture.
- Observability:
  - Metrics and alerts for backup success/failure, backup duration, restore drill outcomes.
  - Runbook links embedded into alerts and incident bot shortcuts.

Out of scope (explicit)
- Building a fully managed customer DR service (this is tooling + documentation for customer operators and Solutions Eng).
- Re-architecting core data persistence across the entire platform; changes are limited to enabling backups/restore and safe operational hooks.

Stakeholders and owners
- Eng Private Deployments: primary engineering owner for installer/packaging changes and customer-facing operational flows.
- SRE + Infrastructure: reliability targets, alerting, game day facilitation, and validation in realistic failure scenarios.
- Security & Compliance: encryption defaults, key handling, evidence expectations, and customer security review readiness.
- Developer Experience (Docs): publishable operator documentation and cross-linking with existing deployment/upgrade guides.
- Solutions Engineering / Professional Services: ensures procedures match real customer environments and supports pilot rollouts.

Timeline (hypothetical)
- Phase 0 (1–2 weeks): Requirements + state inventory, customer constraints intake, success metrics definition.
- Phase 1 (2–4 weeks): Design + ADRs, prototype scripts/jobs, storage target support matrix.
- Phase 2 (3–5 weeks): Implementation across installer/helm/terraform + CI validation + initial docs drafts.
- Phase 3 (2–3 weeks): Restore drills + game days + alert tuning + hardening; pilot with 1–2 Private customers.
- Phase 4 (1–2 weeks): GA docs + internal training + support handoff (CS/SRE runbooks, escalation paths).

Key deliverables
- Versioned backup/restore CLI/scripts integrated with redwood-private-installer.
- Helm chart changes for scheduled backups and one-shot restore jobs.
- Terraform examples for VPC/private storage targets + IAM/KMS wiring.
- Confluence runbooks and DR planning templates.
- Observability dashboards/alerts and an incident-bot shortcut for quick status.

Constraints and considerations
- Must work in restricted networks (private subnets; on-prem without public internet).
- Must minimize sensitive data exposure and support customer-owned encryption keys.
- Must be compatible with upgrade/rollback flows (backup before upgrade; restore after failed upgrade).
- Must produce clear operator-facing failure modes and troubleshooting guidance for Support/Solutions Eng.

files.description: Published overview of the Day-2 ops toolkit: protected state inventory, supported deployment modes, prerequisites, and links to runbooks/scripts. Defines terminology, scope boundaries, and ownership.

Design-oriented Confluence page describing backup architecture (job runners, credentials, encryption), supported storage backends (S3/GCS/Azure/NFS/minio), and a compatibility matrix for VPC vs on-prem.
Step-by-step operator runbook to generate a backup, verify integrity, confirm encryption settings, and validate restore prerequisites. Includes CLI commands, expected outputs, and common errors.
Runbook for restoring a failed Private cluster in-place: prechecks, maintenance mode, DB restore/PITR flow, artifact restore, restart order, smoke tests, and rollback if validation fails.
Runbook for restore into a new Kubernetes cluster/VPC: bootstrap steps, restoring control plane first, re-pointing DNS/TLS, validating API reachability, and cutover checklist.

Guidance for RPO/RTO tiers, cost tradeoffs, and recommended configurations (backup frequency, retention, cross-region replication). Includes example target profiles for regulated enterprise customers.
On-prem/air-gapped specific doc: offline artifact handling, staging repositories, key management patterns, and how to run backups without external endpoints.
Policy/runbook addendum requiring backup gates before upgrades; includes automation hooks, evidence to attach to change requests, and minimum validation steps before proceeding.

SRE-facing troubleshooting guide for backup failures: alert interpretation, log locations, known failure modes (permissions, storage throttling, DB lock contention), and escalation criteria to Eng Private.
Reliability initiative doc defining quarterly DR game days for Private: scenarios, success criteria, evidence capture, and action item tracking.
Reusable template for DR restore drills: scenario setup, timeline capture, RTO measurement, verification steps, and retro prompts.
ADR covering backup artifact format, encryption scheme, key ownership boundaries, and why the chosen approach works across VPC and on-prem.
Security guidance on key handling for backups (KMS/HSM integration, rotation expectations, least privilege), plus a checklist used during customer security reviews.
Dashboards/alerts spec: metrics emitted by backup jobs, SLO-like targets for backup success rate, alert thresholds, and runbook link conventions.
PR: Introduce `rw-private-dr` CLI subcommands for `backup create`, `backup verify`, and `restore plan`. Includes argument parsing, config schema, and initial docs in repo README.
PR: Add storage backend adapters (S3 + minio) with server-side encryption options and IAM policy examples. Includes unit tests and a small integration test harness.
PR: Implement Postgres backup/PITR helpers (pg_dump + WAL archiving configuration) and restore sequencing logic for control plane services.
PR: Add backup retention pruning and idempotent re-run behavior; includes safety checks to prevent deleting “latest known good” snapshots.
PR: Restore validation gate: run health checks and smoke tests against private API endpoints; fail restore if critical checks do not pass.
PR: Add “maintenance mode” toggles during restore to block write paths, with clear operator messaging and rollback steps.
PR: Air-gapped support improvements: allow local file bundle backups and offline restore from a mounted repository; updates to config validation.
PR: Add Helm chart templates for scheduled backup CronJobs and one-shot restore Jobs, including secret mounts and resource requests/limits guidance.
PR: Add PodDisruptionBudget and concurrency safeguards to prevent overlapping backups and to reduce DB contention during peak traffic.
PR: Expose config values for backup windows, timeouts, and retry policies; includes values.yaml examples and upgrade notes.
PR: Terraform module updates for Private backups: S3 bucket + KMS key wiring, least-privilege IAM policies, and private endpoint/VPC gateway notes.
PR: Add example topology for cross-region replication of backup bucket and “break-glass” restore IAM role pattern.
PR: Add backup/restore dashboards: job success rate, duration percentiles, last successful backup age, and restore drill annotations.
PR: Add alerts for missed backup windows and repeated failures; includes runbook links and noise-reduction logic.
PR: Add `/backup-status` and `/restore-checklist` shortcuts in incident-bot; posts links to Confluence runbooks and relevant dashboards.
PR: Add an internal SLO-like objective for Private backup success (per cluster) and error-budget style reporting used by SRE.
PR: Publish operator docs for Private backup/restore and DR planning; includes navigation updates and cross-links to upgrade/rollback docs.
PR: Emit structured events/metrics from control plane components to support backup/restore observability (e.g., DB write quiesce, maintenance mode state).
PR: Add API endpoint protection during maintenance/restore mode (reject writes with actionable error messages) and integration tests.
Linear epic: “Day-2 Ops Toolkit: Backup/Restore (Private)” with goals, non-goals, milestones, acceptance criteria, and links to ADR/runbooks.
Task: Inventory stateful components in Private deployments; define what must be backed up and how to validate completeness.
Task: Define backup storage target support matrix (S3/minio/NFS/etc.) and constraints for air-gapped on-prem.
Task: Implement `backup create` in private installer (DB dump + artifact snapshot) with encryption and retention policy.
Task: Implement `restore plan` and `restore execute` with validation gates and a rollback path.
Task: Add Helm chart primitives (CronJob/Job) and safe concurrency controls; includes acceptance criteria and test plan.
Task: Add Terraform examples for VPC + KMS wiring; include least-privilege IAM policies and documentation.
Task: Observability requirements—metrics, dashboards, and alerts for backup/restore success and duration; links to observability-pack PRs.
Task: DR game day #1 planning issue—scenario definition (lost control plane DB), evidence checklist, and success criteria (RTO/RPO).
Task: DR game day #1 follow-ups—list of discovered gaps (docs clarity, timeouts, permissions), owners, and deadlines.
Task: Security review checklist for backup encryption + key handling; coordinates with Security Engineering and GRC.
PM issue: Define GA success metrics for Private backup/restore (operator time, restore drill pass rate), packaging, and documentation readiness criteria.
Task: Add maintenance-mode API behavior and write-path blocking during restore; includes backwards compatibility notes.
Task: Customer pilot planning (2 design partners): environment prerequisites, schedule, and feedback collection template.
Task: Support handoff—create troubleshooting runbook, escalation paths, and “known issues” list for Private backup/restore.
Thread coordinating initial RPO/RTO targets and what SRE considers “must-have” automation vs operator steps; includes comments on paging/alerts.

Working doc outline for the toolkit docs: sections, screenshots needed, open questions, and links to relevant Confluence pages and PRs.

Template for pilot feedback: environment, backup target, restore steps, time-to-complete, friction points, and requested changes.
Checklist used by Release Engineering to ensure backups are taken and verified before Private upgrades; includes sign-off fields and links.
Table/test matrix of backend combinations (S3+KMS, minio, NFS) across k8s versions and on-prem constraints; includes pass/fail notes.
Fireflies transcript: technical deep dive with an enterprise Private prospect/customer focusing on DR expectations, RPO/RTO, and how Redwood’s toolkit works in VPC + on-prem.

HubSpot company record for an enterprise Private customer/prospect with strict DR needs: stage, stakeholders, requirements (on-prem + air-gapped constraints), recent calls (Fireflies ids), and next steps.
